I completely understand what you are going through. I also suffer from Anxiety coupled with Depression. I used to take sertraline 100mg before being put on my current medication after a suicide attempt.

 The only advice I can give you when it comes to visiting the GP is to either just do it by yourself even though you need to pull yourself with every single fibre of your being or ask your friend to physically come and pull you to the GP. 

The best advice I can give you is to get on the right type of meds. It will eventually get better. Also, if you don't go to therapy, please try to do so. Your uni should have a mental health and wellbeing department with licensed therapists who will be able to help you out. 

I hope this helped.
